\section[(dialogue)]{Places, this and that, and actions — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MW-R109-first-pass-places-this-and-that-and-actions}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to lose and to hit.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a gate, a gateway, a mansion, a fair, a weekly market
  \item this, like this, like that, which, who
  \item all, another, our own, someone, each
  \item to bathe, to cook, to make, to break, to join
  \item to buy, to uncover, to call, to ask for, to look
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A gate? (\textbf{\mw{दरवाजो}}, \emph{darvājo}.) A gateway? (\textbf{\mw{पोळ}}, \emph{poḷ}.) A mansion? (\textbf{\mw{हवेली}}, \emph{havelī}.) A fair? (\textbf{\mw{मेळो}}, \emph{meḷo}.) A weekly market? (\textbf{\mw{हाट}}, \emph{hāṭ}.) This? (\textbf{\mw{यो}}, \emph{yo}.) Like this? (\textbf{\mw{इसो}}, \emph{iso}.) Like that? (\textbf{\mw{उसो}}, \emph{uso}.) Which? (\textbf{\mw{किसो}}, \emph{kiso}.) Who? (\textbf{\mw{कुण}}, \emph{kuṇ}.) All? (\textbf{\mw{सगळा}}, \emph{sagḷā}.) Another? (\textbf{\mw{दूजो}}, \emph{dūjo}.) Our own? (\textbf{\mw{आपणो}}, \emph{āpṇo}.) Someone? (\textbf{\mw{कोई}}, \emph{koī}.) Each? (\textbf{\mw{हरेक}}, \emph{harek}.) To bathe? (\textbf{\mw{न्हावणो}}, \emph{nhāvṇo}.) To cook? (\textbf{\mw{पकावणो}}, \emph{pakāvṇo}.) To make? (\textbf{\mw{बणावणो}}, \emph{baṇāvṇo}.) To break? (\textbf{\mw{तोड़णो}}, \emph{toṛṇo}.) To join? (\textbf{\mw{जोड़णो}}, \emph{joṛṇo}.) To buy? (\textbf{\mw{खरीदणो}}, \emph{kharīdṇo}.) To uncover? (\textbf{\mw{उघाड़णो}}, \emph{ughāṛṇo}.) To call? (\textbf{\mw{बुलावणो}}, \emph{bulāvṇo}.) To ask for? (\textbf{\mw{मांगणो}}, \emph{māṅgṇo}.) To look? (\textbf{\mw{जोवणो}}, \emph{jovṇo}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{More everyday actions — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MW-R109-second-pass-more-everyday-actions}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to stay and to read.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to stay, to read, to know, to fill, to pull
  \item to push, to lift, to drop, to burn, to sew
  \item to weave, to dye, to apply, to remove, to spread out
  \item to wake someone, to save, to get down, to swim, to jump
  \item to fall, to get tired, to win, to lose, to hit
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To stay? (\textbf{\mw{रैवणो}}, \emph{raivṇo}.) To read? (\textbf{\mw{बांचणो}}, \emph{bā̃chṇo}.) To know? (\textbf{\mw{जाणणो}}, \emph{jāṇṇo}.) To fill? (\textbf{\mw{भरणो}}, \emph{bharṇo}.) To pull? (\textbf{\mw{खींचणो}}, \emph{khī̃chṇo}.) To push? (\textbf{\mw{ठेलणो}}, \emph{ṭhelṇo}.) To lift? (\textbf{\mw{उठावणो}}, \emph{uṭhāvṇo}.) To drop? (\textbf{\mw{गेरणो}}, \emph{gerṇo}.) To burn? (\textbf{\mw{बाळणो}}, \emph{bāḷṇo}.) To sew? (\textbf{\mw{सीवणो}}, \emph{sīvṇo}.) To weave? (\textbf{\mw{बुणणो}}, \emph{buṇṇo}.) To dye? (\textbf{\mw{रंगणो}}, \emph{raṅgṇo}.) To apply? (\textbf{\mw{लगावणो}}, \emph{lagāvṇo}.) To remove? (\textbf{\mw{हटावणो}}, \emph{haṭāvṇo}.) To spread out? (\textbf{\mw{बिछावणो}}, \emph{bichhāvṇo}.) To wake someone? (\textbf{\mw{जगावणो}}, \emph{jagāvṇo}.) To save? (\textbf{\mw{बचावणो}}, \emph{bachāvṇo}.) To get down? (\textbf{\mw{उतरणो}}, \emph{utarṇo}.) To swim? (\textbf{\mw{तैरणो}}, \emph{tairṇo}.) To jump? (\textbf{\mw{कूदणो}}, \emph{kūdṇo}.) To fall? (\textbf{\mw{पड़णो}}, \emph{paṛṇo}.) To get tired? (\textbf{\mw{थकणो}}, \emph{thakṇo}.) To win? (\textbf{\mw{जीतणो}}, \emph{jītṇo}.) To lose? (\textbf{\mw{हारणो}}, \emph{hārṇo}.) To hit? (\textbf{\mw{मारणो}}, \emph{mārṇo}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
